title: Avoozl machine host configuration
description: Machine-local, non-secret registration for the workspaces served by one Avoozl host.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Ignored and dropped on the next save. lanes.local in the machine Avoozl configuration sets how many chats this machine runs.

serve.description: Run the standalone page under this machine's supervisor. Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

enabled.description: Start avoozl serve as a supervised child, and restart it when it exits. It prints no owner link: run avoozl serve link at this machine's shell.

port.description: A fixed port, so the address stays the same across restarts. Omit for a random free port.

links.description: Where this machine's page opens worker chats (direct-links). Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

dashboard.description: The Kiro Crew web dashboard address the standalone page opens chats in: https, or http to this machine. An address only, no sign-in in it.

desktop.description: On the standalone page, offer Open in Kiro Crew, which opens a local chat in the Kiro Crew desktop app (kirocrew://).

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Ignored and dropped on the next save. lanes.local in the machine Avoozl configuration sets how many chats this machine runs.
